## Paper status

- Paper I: `RESULTS_AVAILABLE` for three mutually record-disjoint published-manual-transcription California evaluations: v001 50 documents/697 intervals, v002 100 documents/1770 intervals, and prospective v003 100 documents/31 counties/154 pages/1788 intervals. RapidOCR/Tesseract F1 was 0.390/0.325, 0.450/0.346, and 0.383/0.330. Additional real evidence includes a 35-document/80-interval PDF-content-group held-out benchmark, a 46-record/3,332-interval source-disjoint official-database transfer panel, and a two-document/62-interval Raft River benchmark. Representative multilingual source-disjoint manually transcribed Gold remains `NOT COMPLETED`.
- Paper II: `RESULTS_AVAILABLE` for three mutually disjoint California evaluations: unselective constraints raised F1 from 0.390 to 0.514 (FCR 0.165), 0.450 to 0.564 (FCR 0.177), and prospectively 0.383 to 0.470 (FCR 0.210). A policy frozen before v003 accepted 23/57 proposed document corrections, reached F1 0.464, FCR 0.197, and still worsened one document; the simple net-expansion rule therefore failed to establish safe correction. Additional evidence includes real metadata abstention, controlled Synthetic ablation, and Swissgeol positive/negative held-out applications. Broader multimodal attribution and a stronger prospectively validated abstention policy remain `NOT COMPLETED`.
- Paper III: `MANUSCRIPT_IN_PROGRESS` with a real structured-source controlled comparison, 35-document first/four-boundary surfaces, 540 seeded repetitions across six error classes, an external 88-document page-coordinate evaluation, and a partial 35-document page-coordinate surface workflow; page-derived collar extraction, real stratigraphic modelling, and timed human study `NOT COMPLETED`.

## Boundary

Synthetic and Silver outputs are never promoted to human Gold. The authoritative
interval tier is limited to source-agreed numeric boundaries and is not described
as human annotation. The California Gold tier is explicitly a published USGS manual
transcription with published QC, not a new project annotation. Automated compliance is limited to captured licence/source
evidence and text metadata; visual privacy, sensitive-location absence, and geological correctness remain
unestablished without the corresponding evidence.
